title: Rann Utsav
subtitle: White Rann · Kutch Desert · Cultural Festival
inclusions: Sleeper Train Tickets both ways (3AC upgrade available)
AC Tempo Traveller/Bus for local sightseeing
Premium AC Tent Stay (Twin Sharing) in Dhordo

itinerary.title: Mumbai to Bhuj
itinerary.description: Catch train from Dadar Western Railway Station at approximately 2:30 PM. Overnight train journey.

itinerary.title: Dhordo and White Rann
itinerary.description: Reach Bhuj Railway Station at approximately 7:00 AM. Transfer to Dhordo tent accommodation. Freshen up. Lunch. Leisure time. Evening visit to White Rann Desert. Dinner and rest at Dhordo.

itinerary.title: White Rann and Kalo Dungar
itinerary.description: Early morning White Rann visit. Breakfast. Leisure and activity time. Lunch. Evening visit to Kalo Dungar and Gandhi Nu Gam village. Enjoy cultural activities. Dinner and rest.

itinerary.title: Bhuj Sightseeing + Return
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check out from tents. Bhuj sightseeing: Kutch Museum, Aaina Mahal, Prag Mahal, Sharad Baug Palace, Swaminarayan Temple. Dinner en route. Catch return train at approximately 10:00 PM. Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai at approximately 2:00 PM. Return home with sweet memories!
